title: General Hux
subtitle: The First Order
description: Young, ambitious and ruthless, General Armitage Hux of the First Order was a firm believer in the technology developed by their evil regime. In order to destroy the stability of the New Republic, he was the one who gave the order to fire the impressive Starkiller weapon on Hosnian Prime, sending the galaxy into disarray -but not before giving a fiery speech.
